name: Granite Archive Calendar
author: granitepointsoftware

sections.description:
Granite Archive Calendar makes published WordPress posts easier to find. Visitors browse a monthly archive calendar and select a highlighted date to see matching posts without leaving the page. This is a calendar of published posts, not an events, appointments, or booking calendar.

The Free edition provides one calendar with one administrator-selected post category, month navigation, and links to all public posts on the selected date. Use the [granarca_free_calendar] shortcode on a page or post.

For additional calendars, themes, author and category filters, and post display options, see Granite Archive Calendar Pro.

External Services and Privacy

This plugin includes the Freemius software development kit (SDK), provided by Freemius (https://freemius.com/), for licensing and updates in Pro, optional data collection features, and checkout and upgrade services.

Freemius may process connection information and details voluntarily provided when you use its services. See the Freemius Terms of Service (https://freemius.com/terms/) and Privacy Policy (https://freemius.com/privacy/) for details.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Granite Archive Calendar from WordPress Plugins.
  2. Open Granite Archive Calendar > Calendar Settings, then choose a category and save.
  3. Add [granarca_free_calendar] to a Shortcode block on a page or post.
  4. Publish the page. The calendar displays public published posts from the selected category.
  5. For additional guidance, open Granite Archive Calendar > Documentation.
sections.faq:
How do visitors browse posts?

Visitors select a highlighted date to see matching published posts for that day without leaving the page.

Can Free show posts from multiple categories?

Free supports one selected category per site and one calendar. Granite Archive Calendar Pro provides additional calendars and filtering options.
